title: Pan-Seared Mediterranean Fish Skewers
description: A flavorful and colorful Italian-inspired dish, featuring succulent fish skewers seared to perfection and served with a side of crunchy Mediterranean vegetables.

ingredients.name: Fish (Cod or Tilapia)
ingredients.notes: You can also use other white fish like Mahi or Snapper

ingredients.name: Jagged Skewers
ingredients.notes: Soak in water for 30 minutes before use

ingredients.name: Mediterranean Vegetables
ingredients.amount: 1 cup, mixed ( bell peppers, onions, cherry tomatoes, olives)

instructions: Soak the skewers in water for 30 minutes. Cut the fish into 1-inch pieces and thread onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper. Brush the mixture onto both sides of the fish.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
While the fish is cooking, heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add the Mediterranean vegetables and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until they start to brown.
Add the crispy feta cheese to the pan and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until melted and golden brown.
Remove the fish skewers from the oven and serve immediately with the Mediterranean vegetables and crispy feta cheese.
Garnish with fresh parsley or basil, if desired.
